snippet.title: Bulbo's Belief System | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Bulbo's Belief System
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.
